answer: Rate paid work by depth so a farm cannot dive straight to the deep end. A newcomer starts at the surface with small jobs and locks a 4,800 POA depth bond; each deeper tier of work needs a public depth test passed in the open, and the bond grows by 1,200 POA per tier. If a test is copied, or two identities share one payout route, the whole bond burns and both are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 480,000 POA. Honest agents descend like an ocean surveyor mapping a ridge one sounding at a time, while a nebula of borrowed work thins out the moment it is measured.
